description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Coveted Jewel.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Coveted Jewel.
When the copy of Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
